name: Haramase Onahole Taima-Kishi Euditte ~Chii Nouryoku Kettou Subete o Sonaeta Kanpeki Koujo Ona Ana de Sei Shori Shinagara Ore TUEEE!!~
original_name: 孕ませオナホ退魔騎士ユーディット ～地位能力血統全てを備えた完璧皇女オナ穴で性処理しながら俺TUEEE!!～
source:
The mighty demon-slayer, noble, charismatic, top class at knight's academy,
unassailably forthright and gallant:
the perfect heroine is your perfect f*ckable toy!

Norn/Miel/Cybele's X-rated fantasy tale about you, soiling the Holy Empress Euditte.

She was on her way to glory when you met at the academy.
You were left behind, coveting her from an ever-greater distance.

A monster attack gives you opportunity to stain her purity.
Indeed, it was commanded of you.
"I won't be broken!" she declares.
But the noblest, most charismatic, most gallant Euditte can't defeat the rising tide of pleasure!

Impregnate the perfect hole of a perfect woman: she is a thing to be played with.
